messages:
mae: Dawn check-in — did a controlled drain + recycle of the us-west2 GPU lane, validated 8/12 nodes came back healthy. Blocker: quota bump for reserved T4s still pending (INF-578). Need approval to push temporary capacity. Pushed PR #4321 (shard allocator tweak), pinged for review.

sam: Saw PR, left a couple of inline comments. FYI we have ~6 spare T4s in eu-west1 that could be used as cross-region fallback; adds ~15ms p99 but keeps throughput steady.

noah: +1 on fallback. If we enable it, add latency constraint to avoid bad routing. Example config snippet: 
```
policy:
  fallback: eu-west1
  constraints:
    max_latency_ms: 50
```

jen: Tagged infra and finance on INF-578. Can someone from finance/ops confirm temporary budget for the bump? cc @kia

kia: Finance is ok for a short-term bump for the surge window (48h). Approve up to 10 GPUs. Please include budget code `RDW-ops-surges` in the quota request.

mae: Adding `RDW-ops-surges` to INF-578 and updating the quota request. PR #4321 has updated tests and allocator logs. Current pending GPU batch jobs = 42 (pre-scale).

ops-bot: [alert] queue_length(gpu-preemptible)=42 -> threshold (30) breached. Auto-scale suggestion issued.

sam: Can we prioritize pausing the model rollout canary? Pausing frees ~12% of throughput instantly.

noah: Rollout API has a pause endpoint: `POST /rollouts/789/pause`. Needs rollout perms to execute. Also recommend setting `grace_period: 30s`.

jen: I have perms — pausing rollout now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: rollout 789 paused by jen.

mae: Nice — queue dropped to 28 within ~3 minutes after pause. Monitoring for 30m. Today's plan: finalize quota approval, merge PR #4321 after one more review, and keep an eye on spillover metrics. Blocker (quota) cleared by kia's approval. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
